1784 is Naver’s second headquarters where technologies such as robotics, AI, 5G, and cloud converge. Approximately 100 robots are cloud-controlled to perform various services.

When the labor ministry conducted a special inspection of Naver and its employees after the incident, more than half of 1,982 respondents answered that they had suffered workplace bullying at least once over the past six months. The ministry consequently demanded Naver to improve its workplace culture and planned to fine the company in accordance with labor legislation.

A 37-year-old female programmer who had worked at Naver for over a decade died by suicide in September 2022. After returning from maternity leave the family says she was reassigned to a team unrelated to her specialty, the company allegedly refused flexible work arrangements despite legal requirements for employees with young children, and ignored her complaints about unfair treatment toward working mothers. Naver said it "could not find any proof during its internal investigation."
